$comment: A supervisor seat's forecast extensions: the file `factory forecast extend <session> +<n>m|+<n>h "<why>"` appends to,
~/.local/state/factory/forecast/<session>.json (claudecode scripts/factory/forecast.py, ext_path, save_ext; Argos reads it
to end the forecast window). Hestia 0042 (crossing agent-slack 0022), Q2, Pablo 2026-10-26: "YES! make they facts too":
every extension is a fact of kind forecast_extension, read by the laptop indexer from that folder, read-only, and sent
in the facts ledger (facts-batch.json) like the working-on facts (working-on/expected.json facts).
The history is never cut: an entry once written is never edited, so a fact once sent never changes.
A change edits this file first; then every writer and reader below follows in the same change.

writers.test: none yet reads this file: the writer's test is Hephaistos's

readers.test: to be written by hestia: every valid case gives the listed facts, every must_refuse case gives none and a counted warning

file.location: ~/.local/state/factory/forecast/<session>.json, one file per supervisor session; <session>.json.tmp is the writer's atomic-replace temp and is never read
file.encoding: UTF-8 JSON object, written with sort_keys and indent 1

keys.session: the supervisor session (written by every extend; a file without it takes its name from the file name, less .json)
keys.rule: "from-now" (forecast.py RULE): each entry's end is its own t plus add_min; a file without it reads the same way
keys.extensions: the entries, in the order written; never cut

entry.t: integer, epoch seconds UTC: when the extend was made
entry.started: integer or null, epoch seconds UTC: the launch the extension belongs to (the seat's probe .started); null when no start was resolved
entry.add_min: integer minutes, 1 to 10080 (forecast.py parse_add: at most 7 days), counted from t
entry.end: integer epoch seconds UTC, t + 60 * add_min (stamped by migrate; absent in files written before the from-now rule)
entry.why: non-empty text: why the window was extended (extend refuses an empty one)
entry.by: "<project>/<agent>" of who extended (PROJECT_ID/AGENT_NAME), or one of them, or $USER

file.unknown_keys: an unknown key, in the file or in an entry, is ignored (not refused)

payload.launch: started, as RFC 3339 UTC (Z); absent when started is null
payload.why: why, as written (text, kept and never counted)

fact.note: The window an extension makes is Argos's to compute (the later end wins, nothing stacks; only the entries of one launch count). The fact carries each entry, not the window: forecast accuracy is read against the decision's band (working-on facts, decision.forecast) and against the extended window, at Hestia.

valid.name: a from-now file, two extensions of two launches

extensions.why: usage limit stopped every seat; the review waits on the operator
a third card joined the wave

facts.why: usage limit stopped every seat; the review waits on the operator
a third card joined the wave

valid.name: a file written before the from-now rule: no rule, no session key, no end; one entry with no launch

extensions.why: the gate needs one more run

facts.why: the gate needs one more run

must_refuse.name: the file is not a JSON object
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning, no fact from the file

must_refuse.name: the file is not JSON
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning, no fact from the file (a later pass reads it again)

must_refuse.name: an entry that is not an object
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry; the file's other entries still give their facts

must_refuse.name: no t
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: add_min missing
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: add_min zero
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: add_min past 7 days
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: add_min not a whole number
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: why empty
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry

must_refuse.name: end disagrees with t + 60 * add_min
must_refuse.reading: a counted warning for the entry (migrate always stamps t + 60 * add_min; never guess which is right)

limits.time: epoch seconds in the file; RFC 3339 UTC with Z, to the second, in the fact
limits.files: every *.json in the folder; *.tmp and anything else are not read
